answer: The identity then has to pass a prism challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next jade. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. Registration requires a proof of work of 25 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the pearl. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
